        if isinstance(res, dict) and 'title' in res:
            artists = '|'.join([a['name'] for a in res.get('artists', [])])

    title = info.get('Title','')
    artists = info.get('Artists','')
    # Ensure artists separated by |
    if isinstance(artists, list):
        artists = '|'.join(artists)
    rows.append((title, artists))

# sort for deterministic output by Title then Artists

# Build CSV content manually to avoid csv.writer

def csv_escape(field: str) -> str:
    if field is None:
        field = ''
    # escape double quotes by doubling them
    field = str(field).replace('"', '""')
    return f'"{field}"'

items = []
for sid, info in songs_dict.items():
    title = info.get('Title','')
    artists = info.get('Artists','')
    items.append((str(title), str(artists)))

items.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0].lower(), x[1].lower()))

lines = ['Title,Artists']
for title, artists in items:
    lines.append(f'{csv_escape(title)},{csv_escape(artists)}')

content = '\n'.join(lines) + '\n'
print('num_rows', len(items))
print('content_preview')
print('\n'.join(lines[:4]))
print('...')
